1.Nc3 c5 2.d4 cxd4 3.Qxd4 Nc6 4.Qh4.strategy: Moves the queen to a flank square where it eyes e7 and h7, but both are well defended, so it threatens nothing. White has now spent a second tempo on the queen while Black develops freely.
1.Nc3 c5 2.d4 cxd4 3.Qxd4 Nc6 4.Qh4.name: Dunst Opening: Novosibirsk Variation
1.Nc3 c5 2.d4 cxd4 3.Qxd4 Nc6 4.Qh4.background: Schiller calls the line the Novosibirsk Variation.
